name: symphony
description: Persistent, recoverable project routing through a strong execution lead and task-aware workflow capabilities.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent project routing through a strong execution lead.
interface.longDescription: Symphony makes the root a thin session keeper and gives project decisions, execution, delegation, integration, and verification to a strong lead. Lifecycle hooks protect normal stopping and recover interrupted runs. Each task selects direct, mixed, or delegation-heavy execution and uses the workflow and evidence capabilities actually available.
